rediagnostic_interpretation: Candidate triage is operationally compatible with the bounded real CNInfo pipeline.
The rediagnostic completed all four selected official PDF materializations, text extractions and classifications without a blocker.
One residual low-information performance-briefing attendance notice remained because the announcement title used a legal-name issuer prefix while CNInfo security_name carried a short-name form.
That residual is a triage efficiency miss, not an eligibility correctness failure: the downstream frozen classifier safely returned NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Perfect issuer-name normalization is therefore not an activation prerequisite in V2.8.4.

problem_elimination_decision.hard_requirement: Fail-closed eligibility correctness and official-evidence provenance.
problem_elimination_decision.soft_optimization: Perfect pre-materialization suppression of every low-information administrative notice.
problem_elimination_decision.reason: The residual only adds bounded processing cost; downstream classification preserves correctness. Additional fuzzy/legal-name normalization would add complexity without closing a correctness gap.
